Approach

How the audit works

SEO, AEO, and GEO share the same foundation: a crawlable, credible, well-structured site that answers real buyer questions. This project treats them as overlapping layers rather than separate tactics.

Operating flow

1Buyer questions
2Technical + entity audit
3AEO content strategy
4GEO evidence strategy
5Measurement
6Improvement roadmap

Buyer questions

Map what B2B buyers actually ask during problem discovery, comparison, and provider selection.

Technical + entity audit

Check crawlability, indexability, canonicals, structured data, internal links, and entity signals.

AEO content strategy

Create answer-first content, clear headings, FAQs, comparison tables, and direct next steps.

GEO evidence strategy

Build source-worthy content and entity clarity so AI engines can cite and describe the brand accurately.

Measurement

Track technical readiness, search discovery, AI-answer observations, and qualified commercial intent.

Improvement roadmap

Use evidence to decide what to build, revise, or test next in 30/60/90-day cycles.

Why this order matters

Content that answers the wrong questions will not convert. Technical fixes that ignore buyer intent will not show up in answers. GEO testing without baseline measurement is just anecdotes. The flow keeps strategy, evidence, and measurement in the right sequence.
